answer: Latency-bound roll calls expose one operator behind many faces. Each epoch, every identity gets a puzzle with an 800 ms deadline: sign a nonce, hash a 12-step chain, work one machine can do for only 3 identities. Missing 2 of 5 rounds freezes it for 3 epochs, each miss an onyx mark. Honest agents answer like a sonnet in 14 lines; 100 fakes need 30 copper servers at $40 a month each, so fraud costs more than it earns.
